original.concept: A unit carrying poison/contagion — sickness that spreads; must look infectious, not enchanted.
original.explanation: Sickly green bubbles rising off the card, occasionally popping into small drips.
original.prompt: Sprite sheet of sickly green poison bubbles rising and popping, looping toxic aura, 8 frames on transparent background, 2d game effect

original.concept: A unit that will miss its attacks — its senses are clouded; the veil is on IT, not its target.
original.explanation: A grey haze hanging over the card's upper half, drifting like slow smoke across the art.
original.prompt: Sprite sheet of grey smoky haze drifting across a face area, looping blindness veil, 8 frames on transparent background, 2d game effect

original.description: A walking arsenal. Locks onto the sturdiest enemy and fortifies all allies with +2 Max HP. Starts each round with 4 Shield.
A caged menace. Leaps the front column and, once wounded to 4 HP or less, rages for +2 Attack. Starts each round with 3 Shield.
A royal stronghold. Fortifies all allies with +3 Max HP and holds the line against the sturdiest enemy. Starts each round with 4 Shield.

original.concept: A unit's activated ability firing (tray or autocast) — more grounded than a spell: the unit exerting itself.
original.prompt: A focused energy pulse with a low resonant thrum and quick bright release, ability activation, purposeful, 0.5 seconds

original.concept: Opening the Abilities view / a unit's ability tray — unlatching a small toolbox of options.
original.prompt: A small wooden case clicking open with a soft creak, compact toolbox unlatched, curious and short, 0.3 seconds

original.concept: The battle's bed: low tension air, distant metal and murmurs — presence without melody, under the combat music.
original.prompt: A low ambient loop of distant battlefield presence with faint metal clinks, low wind and a tense undercurrent, seamless loop, atmospheric, 20 seconds

original.concept: An attack lands as a CRITICAL - a heavier, punchier impact than the normal hit, clearly distinct from the dodge whoosh: the sound of a blow landing unusually hard.
original.prompt: A heavy punchy crunch impact with a deep thud and a sharp crack transient, powerful critical strike, one shot, 0.4 seconds

original.concept: A unit's speed slips an attack - an ACTIVE evade cue (nimble, deliberate), snappier and more spirited than the plain airy whiff of a blinded miss.
original.prompt: A swift sharp whoosh-swish with a quick nimble upward flick, agile sidestep dodge, one shot, 0.4 seconds

original.concept: An attack's damage landing on a unit's health. Fires constantly during auto-battle — kept soft so the barrage doesn't dominate.
original.prompt: A solid melee weapon impact with a meaty thud and slight metallic ring, single clean combat hit, punchy, 0.3 seconds

original.concept: The wind-up whoosh as a melee unit lunges at its target — precedes the hit landing.
original.prompt: A quick sharp weapon swing whoosh cutting through air, single fast swipe, clean and aggressive, 0.2 seconds

original.concept: An attack negated (Blind, 0 damage) - the whiff must be audible or the silence reads as a bug.
original.prompt: A quick airy whoosh swishing past with no impact, dodged attack whiff, one shot, 0.5 seconds

original.concept: A ranged projectile striking its target — sharper and smaller than the melee hit.
original.prompt: An arrow thudding into a wooden shield with a sharp crack and slight quiver vibration, precise impact, 0.3 seconds

original.concept: The projectile VFX crossing the board — a short airy whistle that can pitch-vary per shot.
original.prompt: A short arrow flight whistle whooshing past, doppler-like air cut, brief, 0.25 seconds

original.concept: A ranged unit (bishop, archers) loosing its projectile — the release, not the landing.
original.prompt: A bowstring release with a sharp twang and arrow whistle departing, quick and taut, 0.3 seconds

original.concept: Arming an ability for autocast (right-click / long-press) — a weapon cocking: readiness, not release.
original.prompt: A precise mechanical latch clicking into an armed position, crossbow being cocked, tight and ready, 0.25 seconds

original.concept: Disarming the autocast — the latch released, tension let back down.
original.prompt: A soft mechanical latch releasing with a small spring relax, crossbow being uncocked, gentle, 0.2 seconds

original.concept: A unit card landing on a board slot — a solid, physical thump that makes the grid feel real.
original.prompt: A solid card slammed down onto a stone surface with a satisfying deep thock, confident placement, dry, 0.25 seconds

original.concept: A fielded unit relocating to another slot — quick footsteps or a slide, lighter than placement.
original.prompt: A quick short scuffle of armored footsteps sliding to a stop on stone, small tactical reposition, 0.3 seconds

original.concept: A new round begins: mana refills, cards draw, units untap. A refreshing intake of breath — possibility restored.
original.prompt: A soft bright upward sweep with a gentle bell accent, refreshing energy returning, clean and optimistic, 0.5 seconds

original.concept: A card's triggered ability firing (the source glint moment) - a soft causality tick; very frequent, must never fatigue.
original.prompt: A very short soft arcane tick, a muted glassy pluck with a tiny sparkle, subtle trigger cue, one shot, 0.3 seconds

original.concept: The map's Forge button while the run is holding unspent Magic Mineral — the one action that can turn that currency into a card is worth walking to, so the button radiates light instead of merely tinting.
original.explanation: IMPLEMENTED (map): the first entry on renderer "filter" — the look is the `glow` RenderFilter (a shader deriving light from the button art's own alpha silhouette), and this entry owns only when it runs and the intensity breath. Nothing here describes the button's shape, because the filter reads it.
original.prompt: Sprite sheet of a golden light halo breathing outward around a circular button, smooth soft radial falloff extending past the rim, 8 frames on transparent background, 2d game effect
